verdict.rationale: Working Copy's docs mention AI features that send staged diffs to OpenAI (working-copy-docs-5) and an AI Repository Agent (working-copy-docs-29), but there is no mention of any opt-out, data-retention policy, or control preventing that data from being used to train AI models.
